target_customer: Teams at tech companies (support, sales, engineering, product) that lose time searching scattered internal knowledge
problem: Company knowledge is spread across many apps and people, so employees waste time finding answers.
product_category: Workplace search and AI knowledge assistant

founders.name: Prasad Kawthekar
founders.background_notes: Natural language processing background; says he saw the cost of scattered information at his job after Cresta.

founders.name: Praty Sharma
founders.background_notes: Stanford batchmate recruited by Kawthekar; NLP background.

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting to dozens of SaaS APIs with permission aware search was standard but laborious; the 2023 shift to LLM answers added harder retrieval work.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations take effort but are copyable, and larger vendors can build search into their own suites.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large platforms added AI search and Glean scaled, while HubSpot acquired Dashworks in April 2025 for its AI search team.

market_need_then: Scattered knowledge across SaaS tools was a widely felt pain, but no dated spend or complaint data was found for 2020; the 2022 TechCrunch piece framed it as a search engine for internal knowledge.

identity.visual_style: Clean modern marketing site with bold headlines and logo walls
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, contrasts 'the old way' with 'the new way'; company page says 'Make humanity omniscient'

brand_strength.rationale: Professional but not distinctive; no press about the brand itself and it was positioned as a Glean alternative.

pivots.from: Intelligent start page and internal knowledge search
pivots.to: AI assistant answering team questions with LLMs
pivots.why: Large language models made direct answers possible

outcome_analysis: Dashworks started as a start page and search tool for internal knowledge, raised a $4M seed in January 2022 and a $5M extension in July 2023 when it pivoted to an LLM assistant. With a crowded enterprise search field including Glean, it ended in an acqui-style sale to HubSpot in April 2025 to strengthen Breeze AI, with no price disclosed.
notes: Competitor search returned only 2024 to 2026 comparison pages, nothing dated near the batch, so the list is empty. The 5M extension amount comes from a headline snippet. Aggregators give totals from 8M to 14.5M, unreliable. Whether HubSpot kept the product is unclear; Dashworks says the team joined HubSpot.
